title: Extension by zero is left adjoint to restriction on a localized site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a Grothendieck site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $W$ be an object. Give the slice $\mathcal C/W$ the localized topology, with coverings whose underlying families cover in $\mathcal C$. For the abelian sheaf categories $\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ and $\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C/W)$ [def-sp-abelian], the restriction functor $j_W^*:\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C/W)$ has a left adjoint $j_{W!}:\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C/W)\to\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C)$; equivalently, there are natural bijections $\operatorname{Hom}(j_{W!}F,G)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(F,j_W^*G)$ for all $F$ and $G$.

source.place: Modules on Sites, Section 03DH (lemma-extension-by-zero), adjunction assertion
